name: Javier Sepúlveda
bio:
Javier's journey in motorsport began with a childhood fascination for rally racing, fueled by watching the Dakar Rally traverse the Atacama Desert. He pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, focusing on vehicle dynamics and performance optimization. After graduating, Javier started as a junior engineer at a local racing team, quickly demonstrating his ability to streamline operations and improve efficiency. His dedication and technical aptitude led him to Praga Racing, where he initially managed logistics before being promoted to head of operations.

As head of operations, Javier is known for his meticulous planning and calm demeanor under pressure. He believes in fostering a collaborative environment, encouraging open communication between engineers, mechanics, and drivers. He's also deeply committed to continuous improvement, constantly seeking innovative ways to optimize processes and enhance performance. What sets Javier apart is his ability to bridge the gap between the technical aspects of racing and the human element, creating a cohesive and motivated team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave.
physical.description: Javier is of average height, with a lean build, and a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes and diagrams.
Has a particular fondness for Chilean empanadas and brings them to team gatherings.
Insists on listening to classical music while reviewing logistical plans.
